dialogues.speaker: Viktor
dialogues.text: We meet again, Traveler. If you have the time, do you mind doing me a favor? The remuneration will not disappoint.

choices.text: How are you lot still in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Oh? I don't recall doing anything that might warrant overstaying my welcome.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Ah, you mean those fellows living it up at the Goth Grand Hotel? I don't know anything about that, I'm afraid. Not my jurisdiction.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Well, whatever. Let's cut to the chase. You Mondstadt folk do so love to natter on and drag your feet.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Do you remember our previous deal? You help me, and I let you in on some things you'd like to hear.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Same deal this time. You set me up with some of Mondstadt's local specialties, and I'll spin you a little yarn. How does that sound?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Haha, well, get me the goods, and you'll get your story... You won't lose out.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Worry not, we Fatui always deliver.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Alright, alright. Just do it for me, and quickly. I'll be waiting for you inside the Cathedral.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: *sigh* Really now, what a way to make a heist out of a milk run...

choices.text: What do you need those specialties for, anyway?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: Can you not be so... so... wary? I came all this way to Mondstadt. I can't just leave without buying anything, now can I?

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: In any case, it seems like the locals are getting more and more hostile towards us Fatui. I fear we'll have to return to Snezhnaya at any moment.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: So, I don't see the issue with stocking up a little and bringing it all back when the time comes.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I'm not familiar with Mondstadt, and I don't know what specialties to get. You, on the other hand, have been around these parts for far longer.

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: That's why I've come to ask you for help. I'm just buying some things, not plotting to commit some crime...

response.speaker: Viktor
response.text: I say, what's the big idea here? I've never done anything to you. I recall that our previous transaction was quite amiable.
